name: compExactValue_correctness_of_stream_eq_some
statement: ∀ {ifp_n : IntFractPair K}, IntFractPair.stream v n = some ifp_n → v = compExactValue ((of v).contsAux n) ((of v).contsAux <| n + 1) ifp_n.fr

name: of_correctness_of_nth_stream_eq_none
statement: IntFractPair.stream v n = none) : v = (of v).convs (n - 1)
